portraits.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square enemy bestiary portrait for a dark fantasy tabletop game
Primary request: an original portrait of a D&D 2014 Air Elemental, a towering swirling humanoid silhouette made from translucent storm clouds and wind, with a subtle face emerging in the vortex
Scene/backdrop: smoky storm sky with sparse dust and broken debris, uncluttered
Subject: one Air Elemental only
Style/medium: painterly dark fantasy concept art, high detail, readable game icon
Composition/framing: centered single silhouette, head and torso dominant, square crop, circular-safe margins
Lighting/mood: cold rim light through the vortex, ominous and elemental
Color palette: slate blue, charcoal, pale silver highlights
Materials/textures: layered vapor, wisps, dust, soft atmospheric edges
Constraints: no text, no symbols, no border, no frame, no watermark, no extra creatures, no weapons; preserve a clear silhouette at 512x512
Avoid: multiple figures, humanoid hero, fire, armor, UI elements
